{"notes": "Visit 2 (2:45). Fish facing left. Both body lines are now complete and meet at the crossing near x=23. The upper tail fin runs to about (28,6). The lower fin curves down to about (27.3,12.5), where Jack's hands were, and it is dark and connected with no overlap. Open issue: 3 pale, disconnected dominoes at the crossing (about x=23-24, y=8.5-9.5). Nobody mentioned them directly, and I can't attribute them. Sofia flagged an off-line domino there, and this may be it. Re-check on visit 3 that it is fixed.

Sofia: Her claims held up: the belly is in and connected. She spotted a possible gap in the lower fin and took it on, then told both me and Jack. Good proactive coordination, but she acted before confirming Jack's status. Jack corrected her and the picture shows no duplication, so she appears to have deferred. She also flagged the off-line domino. Strong on collaboration and communication. Execution is still unclear.

Hana: Silent again, but the top line she was working on is now finished and meets the crossing. She delivered on the critical path. Communication is weak, so ask her about the crossing.

Omar: His status was mostly accurate, apart from missing the pale cluster at the crossing. He said he'd check the tail joint and help with breaks. Good that he stopped Sofia from duplicating work, but he is still waiting rather than leading. Check whether he fixes the pale dominoes.

Jack: Spoke up clearly this time. His claim of two thirds done fits the picture, and the lower fin is clean. He said 'all connected', which is slightly overstated because of the pale cluster. He pushed back on Sofia politely and constructively. He owes a check of the crossing and upper fin.

No ratings yet."}
